notes: Free basic vet care for cats and dogs for western Queens residents, supported by The Rachael Ray Foundation. Only for owners living in zip codes 11101-11106, 11368, 11369, 11370, 11372, 11373 or 11377 (Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Woodside, Corona, Jackson Heights, Elmhurst and nearby). Bring proof of public assistance: NYCHA, Medicaid, SSI, SSDI, welfare, TANF, or SNAP/WIC. Exams, vaccines, spay/neuter and in-house tests are free for eligible owners. Appointments only: check eligibility and book through the ASPCA's online form. For an emergency, go to an emergency hospital instead.
